title: Two coordinated files
note: The real test of target_files: a new view AND its registration. Models routinely do one and forget the other.
prompt: Add an About page. Create src/views/AboutView.vue with an <h1> reading "About" and a short paragraph. Register it in src/router/index.ts at path /about with the route name 'about'. Import the view at the top of the router file the same way HomeView is imported.
guard_note: Assertions flagged `guard` are regression checks — they hold on the untouched seed and exist to catch a model that rewrites the file and drops existing content. They are scored separately from task assertions.
